resources.convention: The frontend lives entirely in the frontend/ directory of the repository: React 18+ with TypeScript, built with Vite, laid out like the Vite react-ts template (package.json, vite.config.ts, tsconfig.json, index.html, src/main.tsx, src/App.tsx - write these files yourself if they are missing, there is no need to run a project generator). Manage packages with npm; keep the package-lock.json that `npm install` produces in the repository. Structure: src/api (client that calls the backend), src/components (presentational components, props only), src/hooks (state + API calls), src/types.ts (shared types). Function components + hooks, no class components. TypeScript strict, no any. Do not change any file outside frontend/.

resources.convention: Test with Vitest + @testing-library/react + jsdom; the `npm test` script in package.json must be `vitest run` (run once and exit, no watch). Mock fetch in tests, never call the real backend. Every interactive component has at least one behaviour test. `npm run build` (tsc + vite build) must pass. Vitest loads only *.test.ts(x) files; do not let it load another tool's tests.
